attempts.reason: Reset `mockActionFactory` to `null` in `setUp()` to prevent state leakage between test classes running in the same JVM.
Resetting `mockActionFactory` to `null` in `setUp()` ensures that static or instance state leakage from previously run dispatcher test classes does not reuse stale mock expectations.
Resetting all test-specific mock field references in `setUp()` prevents any leakage of mock expectations from previously executed test classes.
